tagline: 蔡司胶片相机，1936 年发布
description: 蔡司于1936年推出的胶片相机。配备Teronar-Anigstigmat f/3.5。快门速度850/16 Fps (Ikoflex I) : Novar 3.5/7.5 cm lens in a Prontor-S shutter 850/16 Lps (Ikoflex I) : Carl Zeiss Jena, or Zeiss-Opton T (coated) Tessar 3.5/7.5 cm lens in a Prontor-S shutter。3 feet 6 inches to infinity.。

specs.英文简介: The Ikoflex II (851/16) is a TLR camera that was made by Zeiss Ikon from 1936 till 1951.
